2026-10-08 每日新论文 5

机器人 · 强化学习 · 通用 AI

生成时间：2026-10-08 09:01 CST。从 891 篇近 30 天的候选论文中筛选。优先保留机器人与强化学习各最多 3 篇，再按分数补齐；最终按分数排列。领域由标题、摘要和关键词自动识别，可能有误差。

本栏优先收录最近发布且未出现在近期日报的 arXiv 论文，不按热度排序；相关性分用于结合你的 Zotero 收藏偏好。

已启用 Zotero-arXiv-Daily 加权摘要相似度：相关性 65%，热度与新鲜度 35%；近期收藏权重更高。

本次合格候选不足 10 篇，实际收录 5 篇。

1. Revisiting Temporal Regularization for Smooth Control in Deep Reinforcement Learning

机器人 / 强化学习 · 公告 2026-10-07 · 综合分 3.45

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.531（相似度分数，不是概率）。

arXiv 新论文；暂无 HF 热度数据，主要根据 Zotero 相关性推荐。

暂无可比较的历史快照；本次根据当前热度和新鲜度排序，未使用增长分。

规则标签：强化学习

中文概述：针对深度强化学习在物理机器人部署中产生的动作震荡问题，本文分析了现有的空间平滑方法可能导致任务性能下降的局限。作者重构了时间正则化的理论基础，证明其能通过时间惩罚项间接实现空间平滑效果。基于此，作者提出了一种名为CATS的方法，通过结合时间正则化与线性递增策略，在减少动作震荡的同时，有效维持了任务性能，并通过仿真及真实环境验证了其有效性。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 作者证明了时间惩罚项能够约束在共享下一状态的当前状态之间的预期动作差异，从而揭示了其对空间平滑的辅助作用。
    摘要依据：We revisit this assumption by proving that the temporal penalty bounds the expected action differences between current states sharing a next state, revealing a spatial effect that empirically extends to spatial smoothness.
  • 提出的CATS方法利用线性递增策略，使策略能够在执行平滑操作前优先学习到高奖励行为，从而更好地平衡性能与平滑度。
    摘要依据：Through linear ramp-up, CATS allows the policy to learn rewarding behavior before progressively smoothing its actions, improving return preservation and both temporal and spatial smoothness.

AI 主题：强化学习

原文摘要节选：Deep Reinforcement Learning policies can produce nonsmooth action oscillations that hinder deployment on physical robots. Existing architectural and penalty-based approaches seek spatial smoothness by directly reducing sensitivity to changes in state inputs, but their broad constraints can degrade task performance as stronger smoothing is pursued. Temporal regularization instead constrains action differences along observed transitions, but has been considered unable to provide the spatial smoothness needed under observation noise. We revisit this assumption by proving that the temporal penalty bounds the expected action differences between current states sharing a next state, revealing a spatial effect that empirically extends to spatial smoothness. Building on this finding, we propose…

论文原文 · PDF

2. QF3: Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients

机器人 / 强化学习 · 公告 2026-10-07 · 综合分 3.42

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.526（相似度分数，不是概率）。

arXiv 新论文；暂无 HF 热度数据，主要根据 Zotero 相关性推荐。

暂无可比较的历史快照；本次根据当前热度和新鲜度排序，未使用增长分。

规则标签：强化学习 · 人形机器人 · 足式运动

中文概述：针对机器人行为学习中流策略（Flow policies）的优化需求，本文提出了QF3（Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients）算法。该算法结合流匹配与评论家（critic）动作梯度，并通过过滤机制仅在动作维度接近重放数据时进行更新，以确保策略训练的可靠性。作者声称，QF3能实现从零开始训练人形机器人运动策略，并支持零样本硬件迁移，在训练效率上较FPO++有显著提升，同时适用于预训练策略的微调。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • QF3通过仅在动作维度接近重放动作时应用评论家梯度，确保了流策略更新的可靠性。
    摘要依据：To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action.
  • 该算法实现了人形机器人运动策略从零开始的训练及其在硬件上的零样本迁移，且训练速度较现有方法提升10倍。
    摘要依据：Paired with a high-throughput off-policy training recipe, it trains humanoid locomotion and motion-tracking policies with a 10x wall-clock speedup over FPO++, a recent on-policy flow RL method.

AI 主题：人形机器人 · 足式运动 · 机器人操作 · Sim-to-Real

原文摘要节选：Flow policies have become a standard policy class for learning robot behaviors from demonstrations, but reinforcement learning is still critical for improving pre-trained flow policies or learning them from scratch through interaction. We introduce QF3 (Fast Flow RL with Filtered Q-Gradients), an online off-policy RL algorithm that trains a flow policy with flow matching plus the critic's action gradient, backpropagated through a one-step prediction of the flow's output. To keep updates where the critic and this prediction are reliable, QF3 applies the critic gradient only to action dimensions that stay near the replay action. To our knowledge, QF3 is the first off-policy flow RL method to train humanoid locomotion policies from scratch and transfer them zero-shot to hardware. Paired with…

论文原文 · PDF

3. SWAP: Stepwise Action Policy Routing for Vision-Language-Action Models

机器人 / 强化学习 · 公告 2026-10-07 · 综合分 3.41

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.524（相似度分数，不是概率）。

arXiv 新论文；暂无 HF 热度数据，主要根据 Zotero 相关性推荐。

暂无可比较的历史快照；本次根据当前热度和新鲜度排序，未使用增长分。

规则标签：强化学习 · 视觉语言动作 · 离线强化学习

中文概述：针对视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在不同任务状态和环境下表现不一致的问题，作者提出了一种名为SWAP（StepWise Action Policy Routing）的框架。该方法将策略路由建模为离线强化学习问题，通过学习一个路由评判器，在执行过程的每个决策步骤动态选择最优的VLA策略，而非仅依赖单一模型，从而提升了机器人操作任务的成功率和执行效率。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • SWAP框架通过学习路由评判器，实现了在机器人执行过程中根据观测动态选择最适合的VLA策略，克服了单一策略在复杂环境下的局限性。
    摘要依据：SWAP formulates policy routing as an offline reinforcement learning problem, learning a routing critic that selects the most appropriate policy at each decision step given the current observation.
  • 实验结果表明，在真实世界的DROID操作任务中，该方法相比固定策略基准提升了最高33%的成功率，并缩短了操作步长。
    摘要依据：SWAP improves over fixed-policy execution and routing baselines, giving absolute improvements in real-world task success up to 33% while reducing successful trajectory robot action step length by 28.3%.

AI 主题：机器人操作 · 离线强化学习 · 视觉语言动作

原文摘要节选：Robot manipulation systems using Vision-Language-Action (VLA) model backbones typically use just one VLA for task execution. However, individual VLAs do not perform well across different task states and environments. We introduce a framework for dynamically composing multiple VLA policies during execution: StepWise Action Policy Routing (SWAP). SWAP formulates policy routing as an offline reinforcement learning problem, learning a routing critic that selects the most appropriate policy at each decision step given the current observation. SWAP enables robots to select new policies to execute online rather than committing to a single policy for the duration of an episode. We evaluate SWAP on both real-world DROID manipulation tasks and LIBERO simulation experiments. SWAP improves over…

论文原文 · PDF

4. Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning

机器人 / 强化学习 · 公告 2026-10-07 · 综合分 3.40

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.523（相似度分数，不是概率）。

arXiv 新论文；暂无 HF 热度数据，主要根据 Zotero 相关性推荐。

暂无可比较的历史快照；本次根据当前热度和新鲜度排序，未使用增长分。

规则标签：强化学习 · 机器人操作

中文概述：本文提出了一种名为TIGER的奖励构建与预训练框架，旨在提升稀疏奖励下桌面机器人操作任务的强化学习效率。该方法将动作分块模仿策略转化为任务空间进度估计器，通过将预测的动作分块映射为短时程末端执行器参考轨迹，向强化学习智能体提供密集进度奖励。作者声称，该方法在预训练阶段通过模仿引导的超前信号减轻了保守价值惩罚，从而在实验中提升了早期采样效率并降低了安全性违规率。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • TIGER利用任务空间进度估计器为智能体提供密集奖励，从而在稀疏奖励环境中提升了学习效率。
    摘要依据：TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective.
  • 该框架通过预训练阶段的模仿引导信号减少了离线探索，提高了样本效率并降低了安全性违规。
    摘要依据：During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during early online RL.

AI 主题：机器人操作 · 强化学习 · 模仿学习

原文摘要节选：We introduce Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning (TIGER), a reward-construction and pretraining framework for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation. TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective. During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during…

论文原文 · PDF

5. Humanoid Horizon: Extending Task Horizon in Whole-Body Loco-Manipulation via Parallel Training, Dynamic Starting, and Reward Gating

机器人 · 公告 2026-10-07 · 综合分 3.32

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.510（相似度分数，不是概率）。

arXiv 新论文；暂无 HF 热度数据，主要根据 Zotero 相关性推荐。

暂无可比较的历史快照；本次根据当前热度和新鲜度排序，未使用增长分。

规则标签：人形机器人

中文概述：针对室内杂乱环境下人形机器人长周期全身运动与操作任务的挑战，作者提出了Humanoid Horizon框架。该方法通过并行训练策略确保各阶段梯度更新，利用动态起始机制增强状态覆盖，并引入奖励门控防止后续阶段对早期成果的破坏。实验结果表明，该方法在双物体基准任务中实现了超过80%的阶段成功率，且在长序列任务中表现出比现有基线更平缓的性能衰减。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出并行训练策略、动态起始机制和奖励门控，解决了长周期全身运动与操作任务中的奖励偏置和灾难性遗忘问题。
    摘要依据：In this work, we introduce Humanoid Horizon, a unified policy framework designed to overcome these limitations through three interrelated mechanisms.
  • Humanoid Horizon框架在包含两个物体的基准测试中，达到了超过80%的各阶段成功率。
    摘要依据：Collectively, these strategies achieve per-stage success rates exceeding 80\% on the two-object LHM-Humanoid benchmark (350 training scenes, 66 held-out scenes).

AI 主题：人形机器人 · 足式运动 · 机器人操作

原文摘要节选：Cluttered indoor environments, where large and heavy objects are scattered across diverse surfaces, require humanoid robots to sequentially navigate, grasp, transport, and accurately place each item at its target location within a single uninterrupted episode. This long-horizon, whole-body loco-manipulation task remains a significant challenge for current methods. Previous approaches often suffer from two main issues: easy-reward bias, where training overemphasizes early transport stages at the expense of later ones, and catastrophic forgetting, where focusing on later stages leads to a decline in earlier-stage performance. In this work, we introduce Humanoid Horizon, a unified policy framework designed to overcome these limitations through three interrelated mechanisms. The Parallel…

论文原文 · PDF

中文概述：针对视觉语言动作（VLA）模型在推理阶段的验证器引导策略，本文提出了一种名为DiVeR的方法。该方法通过计算采样动作表征的离散度来评估决策关键性，并利用该信号对验证器进行重加权，聚焦于动作选择对任务结果影响显著的关键状态。实验证明，DiVeR在LIBERO、RoboCasa及真实Franka机器人任务中，以极低的推理开销提升了任务成功率。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

    摘要依据：To address this, we propose DiVeR, which estimates decision criticality from the dispersion of sampled action representations. DiVeR then uses this signal to reweight verifier learning toward states where action selection is most consequential, without requiring step-level annotations or additional environment interaction.
  • 在无需额外环境交互或步骤级标注的情况下，该方法在多个仿真基准及真实机器人实验中实现了性能提升且推理开销极低。
    摘要依据：Across LIBERO, RoboCasa, and real-world experiments on a Franka Research 3 robot, DiVeR consistently improves task success through more effective verifier-guided action selection, while adding negligible verifier inference overhead.

原文摘要节选：Scaling robot data and model capacity has improved Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies, but further progress is constrained by the high cost of robotic data. 1. LocoWM: High-Precision Locomotion through World-Model-Guided Residual Adaptation

Zotero 摘要相关性：0.552（相似度分数，不是概率）。

规则标签：足式运动 · 世界模型

中文概述：针对高精度足式运动中端到端优化不足及反应式控制滞后的问题，本文提出了LocoWM框架。该方法引入行动条件世界模型，通过预测未来物理状态序列来指导残差适配器，从而主动生成动作修正以补偿预期偏差。研究采用两阶段训练策略，实现了基本运动能力学习与高精度补偿任务的解耦，实验表明该方法在地形平整、加速度补偿及抗干扰能力方面优于对比基线。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • LocoWM通过行动条件世界模型预测未来状态，实现了高精度运动的预主动式残差适配。
    摘要依据：A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate for anticipated deviations.
  • 通过两阶段训练策略，将基本运动能力的获取与精密任务的适配过程分离开来。
    摘要依据：Two-stage training first learns locomotion and action-conditioned dynamics, then freezes both modules while training the adapter, separating locomotion acquisition from precision adaptation.
  • 在地形平整、加速度补偿及抗干扰等测试中，表现出比端到端和反应式残差基线更高的控制精度。
    摘要依据：Experiments spanning terrain leveling, acceleration compensation, and push recovery demonstrate improved control precision and disturbance robustness over end-to-end and reactive residual baselines.

AI 主题：足式运动

原文摘要节选：High-precision locomotion combines motion-command tracking with precise regulation of task-relevant physical states, enabling robots to interact reliably with their surroundings during motion. Joint end-to-end optimization can leave precision objectives insufficiently optimized, while reactive residual control adjusts actions only after deviations become observable. We present \textbf{LocoWM}, a world-model-guided preactive residual adaptation framework for high-precision locomotion. A base policy provides command-following locomotion, while an action-conditioned world model predicts a sequence of future physical states from proprioceptive history and the proposed base action. A residual adapter conditions on this predicted sequence to generate additive action corrections that compensate…

中文概述：本文针对移动机器人在未知环境中因陷入局部最优而难以到达目标的问题，提出了一种名为LME（Local-Minimum Escaper）的程序化分层框架。该方法通过基于局部观测的启发式准则显式生成子目标，引导机器人脱离障碍物包围区域。实验表明，LME无需额外训练即可与多种底层运动规划器集成，在仿真及四足和差速机器人实地测试中展现了稳健的导航性能和泛化能力。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • LME框架通过启发式准则显式生成子目标以摆脱局部最优，无需额外的学习过程即可实现，且与底层运动规划器解耦。
    摘要依据：LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and candidate-location safety. A local planner then generates low-level motion commands toward the selected subgoal.
  • 该方法表现出良好的泛化性，不仅能在不同环境下保持鲁棒导航，还能有效增强现有局部规划器的脱困能力。
    摘要依据：Furthermore, the generated subgoals can be used to guide different local planners, substantially improving their ability to escape local minima.

原文摘要节选：Mapless navigation in unknown and partially observable environments remains challenging for mobile robots, particularly when local minima prevent the robot from making progress toward its goal. Existing local navigation methods often lack an explicit mechanism for escaping such situations, while deep reinforcement learning (DRL) approaches typically learn recovery behaviors implicitly through reward design and policy optimization. In this work, we propose \textbf{LME} (Local-Minimum Escaper), a programmatic hierarchical framework that explicitly generates and reasons subgoals to guide robots out of local-minimum regions. LME operates solely on local observations and selects candidate subgoals using interpretable heuristic criteria that account for both surrounding obstacle geometry and…

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出SCOOT算法，通过利用精英样本优化、混合专家策略及学习课程，有效应对高风险运动控制中的尖锐奖励分布。
    摘要依据：we propose and evaluate State-Conditioned Shooting (SCOOT), a novel DRL algorithm that builds on advantage-weighted regression (AWR) with three key modifications: 1) Performing policy optimization only using elite samples, allowing the policy to better latch on to the rare high-reward action samples; 2) Utilizing a mixture-of-experts (MoE) policy, to allow switching between reward landscape modes depending on the state; 3) Adding a distance regularization term and a learning curriculum to encourage exploring diverse strategies before adapting to the most advantageous samples.
  • 通过物理台球模拟实验，证实了算法能够实现极高的动作精度并发现多种射击策略。
    摘要依据：We showcase our features' performance in learning physically-based billiard shots demonstrating high action precision and discovering multiple shot strategies for a given ball configuration.

AI 主题：强化学习

    摘要依据：RISE ranks bounded objective changes using response sensitivity estimated from cached rollouts and accepts updates only when they produce verified response progress while preserving kicking reliability.

    摘要依据：Experiments show that RISE evolves the ordinary kick into a high-spin curved kick with 11.55 rad/s mean ball spin, improves the mean evaluation score by 19.8% over a learning-progress curriculum, and raises joint target attainment from 15.2% to 50.9%.

    摘要依据：We introduce SeeQ (Subtask-elicited Q-functions), which instead learns Q-values for the currently active subtask. This shortens the value-prediction horizon and enables effective learning with temporal-difference (TD) objectives.

中文概述：针对视觉策略学习在接触协调中的计算开销及局部最优问题，本文提出了一种采样引导策略搜索（SGPS）方法。该方法结合了基于采样的模型预测控制与一阶策略梯度优化，通过模仿学习初始化策略，并交替进行采样细化与短时程梯度更新。作者声称该方法能有效利用深度观测进行学习，在机器人运动与操作任务中表现出良好的训练效率，并支持在真机上进行零样本迁移。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出SGPS算法，结合基于采样的模型预测控制与一阶策略梯度优化，解决了传统梯度方法在接触模式优化中的局部收敛问题。
    摘要依据：To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization.
  • 采用解耦的一阶策略梯度公式，实现了直接从深度观测中学习，无需依赖状态策略教师。
    摘要依据：For visual policy training, we use a decoupled FoPG formulation that excludes rendering from the computation graph, enabling direct learning from depth observations without a state-policy teacher.
  • 验证了算法在多项模拟任务中的有效性，并实现了视觉策略向实体四足机器人的零样本迁移。
    摘要依据：For hardware deployment, the distilled policy transfers zero-shot to a real Go2 and uses onboard depth to autonomously trot, crawl, clear hurdles, and switch between these behaviors.

AI 主题：四足机器人 · 人形机器人 · Sim-to-Real · 机器人操作

原文摘要节选：Learning visual policies for locomotion and manipulation requires coordinating contact with the environment and can incur substantial computation and GPU memory costs. First-order policy gradients (FoPG) reduce training cost through differentiable simulation, but local optimization can converge to unintended contact patterns. To address this shortfall, we propose Sampling-Guided Policy Search (SGPS), which couples recurring action-target refinement by sampling-based model-predictive control with first-order policy optimization. Behavior cloning initializes the policy from sampled actions; training then alternates sampling-based refinement with short-horizon FoPG updates under perturbed initial states and randomized dynamics.     摘要依据：we further design a variable-length encoding strategy that dynamically prunes redundant hover points and optimizes continuous flight parameters concurrently within a unified search space.

中文概述：本文综述了机器人学习与控制中的“世界-动作模型”（WAMs）。WAMs将未来的世界状态预测与可执行的动作生成相结合，旨在解决机器人由于部分可观测性、物理约束和动态任务环境带来的挑战。文章梳理了WAMs与传统世界模型、基于模型的强化学习、视觉语言动作（VLA）策略等领域的关系，提出了统一的分类体系，并讨论了其在操作、导航和自动驾驶中的应用及面临的关键技术挑战。

基于摘要 · Gemini 生成，未经全文核验。

  • 提出了一种将未来世界状态预测与动作生成相结合的WAMs技术分类体系，明确了其与传统世界模型和VLA策略的区别。
    摘要依据：This survey provides a robotics-oriented review of WAMs. We clarify their scope relative to conventional world models, model-based reinforcement learning, action-conditioned video generation, and reactive VLA policies, and organize existing methods through a unified taxonomy covering representations, transition modeling, action interfaces, architectures, training pipelines, data modalities, and scaling strategies.
  • 总结了WAMs在机器人操作、导航及自动驾驶等领域的应用，并探讨了动作对齐、长时记忆与推理效率等关键挑战。
    摘要依据：We further review applications of WAMs in manipulation, navigation, and autonomous driving, and we summarize the datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and protocols used to evaluate WAM systems. Finally, we discuss key challenges in action alignment, world-action factorization, spatial and multi-view consistency, long-horizon memory, neural simulation for closed-loop policy learning, and efficient inference.

AI 主题：机器人操作 · 导航 · 视觉语言动作 · 推理

Beyond mapping observations and language instructions to actions, they must anticipate how candidate actions may affect future states and task-relevant outcomes. 中文概述：本文综述了机器人学习与控制中的“世界-动作模型”（WAMs）。WAMs将未来的世界状态预测与可执行的动作生成相结合，旨在解决机器人由于部分可观测性、物理约束和动态任务环境带来的挑战。文章梳理了WAMs与传统世界模型、基于模型的强化学习、视觉语言动作（VLA）策略等领域的关系，提出了统一的分类体系，并讨论了其在操作、导航和自动驾驶中的应用及面临的关键技术挑战。

    摘要依据：This survey provides a robotics-oriented review of WAMs. We clarify their scope relative to conventional world models, model-based reinforcement learning, action-conditioned video generation, and reactive VLA policies, and organize existing methods through a unified taxonomy covering representations, transition modeling, action interfaces, architectures, training pipelines, data modalities, and scaling strategies.
  • 总结了WAMs在机器人操作、导航及自动驾驶等领域的应用，并探讨了动作对齐、长时记忆与推理效率等关键挑战。
    摘要依据：We further review applications of WAMs in manipulation, navigation, and autonomous driving, and we summarize the datasets, benchmarks, metrics, and protocols used to evaluate WAM systems. Finally, we discuss key challenges in action alignment, world-action factorization, spatial and multi-view consistency, long-horizon memory, neural simulation for closed-loop policy learning, and efficient inference.
